scope: Deterministic actual public near-model offline body-distance bake. No model/texture regeneration or runtime mesh sampling.
proof: For every field cell, floor extrema are obtained by clipping the actual a-d source ground triangles to its rectangle. The body band [minFloor+.22,maxFloor+1.75] contains the existing low-body policy for every center inside that cell.

Distance is the minimum horizontal distance between the ENTIRE cell rectangle and every actual native triangle clipped to that vertical band. Rectangle/polygon intersection gives zero. Solid interiors are also zero; no positive clearance inside a closed volume.
A triangle farther than the current saturated distance in an XZ axis cannot improve that distance; the spatial index only omits triangles farther than maxDistance.

Quantisation rounds down1mm after subtracting1micron, so the stored distance never exceeds the certificate. Native collision requires physicalRadius+.002; legacy coarse collision keeps its original.08 reserve and voxel policy.
The field boundary is2.25m beyond every actual native vertex in XZ. Outside the field, distance to this structure exceeds every supported2.0m radius plus.002 skin; returningInfinity there is safe.
